::: {.why}
A price series is the shadow of a legal contract, and every data problem in week 3 comes from the contract, not from the data vendor.
:::

## What you should be able to do tonight

- State what a common share entitles you to and what it obliges you to, in four clauses, without using the word investment.
- Point at the 2020 Apple split in a raw price series and say why the price fell 75 percent on a day nobody lost money.
